# Expected menu bar structure (PROPOSAL.md section 2 + section 8)
# Format: MENU <name> | ENTRY <label> [shortcut] | SEP | SUBMENU <name>
# ▸ indicates a submenu cascade.

MENU File
  ENTRY New Database ▸ Ctrl+Shift+N
    SUBMENU New Database
      ENTRY Normal
      ENTRY Three-check
      ENTRY Crazyhouse
      ENTRY variant list
  ENTRY Open Database… Ctrl+O
  ENTRY Open Recent ▸
  ENTRY Close Database Ctrl+W
  ENTRY Save Changes Ctrl+S
  SEP
  ENTRY Import ▸
    SUBMENU Import
      ENTRY PGN file(s)…
      ENTRY Games from another database…
  ENTRY Export ▸
    SUBMENU Export
      ENTRY PGN…
      ENTRY HTML report…
      ENTRY Portable archive (.scv)…
      ENTRY Lichess study…
  ENTRY Create Database Archive…
  SEP
  ENTRY Quit Ctrl+Q

MENU Edit
  ENTRY Undo Ctrl+Z
  ENTRY Redo Ctrl+Y
  SEP
  ENTRY Cut Ctrl+X
  ENTRY Copy Ctrl+C
  ENTRY Paste Ctrl+V
  ENTRY Select All Ctrl+A
  ENTRY Find Ctrl+F
  SEP
  ENTRY Keyboard Preferences…
  ENTRY Preferences ▸
    SUBMENU Preferences
      ENTRY Engines…
      ENTRY PGN export options…
      ENTRY Private Player Card…

MENU Game
  ENTRY New Game ▸ Ctrl+Shift+G
  ENTRY Load Game Number…
  ENTRY Next Game Ctrl+Down
  ENTRY Previous Game Ctrl+Up
  ENTRY First Game Ctrl+Home
  ENTRY Last Game Ctrl+End
  ENTRY Random Game
  SEP
  ENTRY Save Game ▸
    SUBMENU Save Game
      ENTRY Replace Game Ctrl+R
      ENTRY Replace Moves Ctrl+V
      ENTRY Add as New Game Ctrl+S
      ENTRY Add to Repertoire ▸
      ENTRY Add Line to Repertoire ▸
  ENTRY Reload from Database
  SEP
  ENTRY Copy Game
  ENTRY Paste Game ▸
    SUBMENU Paste Game
      ENTRY paste last clipbase game
      ENTRY paste from game tab
  ENTRY Merge Game ▸
    SUBMENU Merge Game
      ENTRY merge clipbase
      ENTRY merge from game tab
  ENTRY Export Game… Ctrl+E
  ENTRY Upload to Lichess Study…
  SEP
  ENTRY Game History ▸
    SUBMENU Game History
      ENTRY recent games
      ENTRY Clear History
  ENTRY Close Game

MENU Database
  ENTRY Search ▸
    SUBMENU Search
      ENTRY Plain-Language…
      ENTRY Advanced…

      ENTRY Duplicates…

  ENTRY Reports ▸

      ENTRY Result Check…
      ENTRY Time-Control Profile…
      ENTRY Trends…
  ENTRY Maintenance ▸

      ENTRY Compact…
      ENTRY Strip Move Information…
      ENTRY Strip PGN Tags…
      ENTRY Convert to Native Format…
      ENTRY Recode…
      ENTRY Change Icon…
      ENTRY Repertoire Type ▸
  SEP
  ENTRY Discover Databases…
  ENTRY Properties…
  ENTRY Read-only
  SEP
  ENTRY Player Data ▸
    SUBMENU Player Data
      ENTRY Update Rating Data…
      ENTRY Check Name Spellings…

MENU Board
  ENTRY Start Position ▸
    SUBMENU Start Position
      ENTRY Standard
      ENTRY Chess960
      ENTRY Symm960
      ENTRY Shuffle
      ENTRY Set Up Position…
  ENTRY Set Start Board…
  ENTRY Set Start Position…
  SEP
  ENTRY Flip Board Ctrl+F
  ENTRY Insert Null Move Ctrl+0
  SEP
  ENTRY Board Setup…
  ENTRY Appearance ▸
    SUBMENU Appearance
      ENTRY side to move
      ENTRY material values/bar
      ENTRY border
      ENTRY coordinates
      ENTRY small letters
      ENTRY suggested move
      ENTRY variation arrows
      ENTRY annotation
      ENTRY annotation timeout ▸
      ENTRY sliding variation pane ▸
      ENTRY promoted-piece mark ▸
  SEP
  ENTRY Show Tablebase ▸
    SUBMENU Show Tablebase
      ENTRY show
      ENTRY online lookup
      ENTRY local folder…

MENU Analysis

  ENTRY Engines…

  ENTRY Fact-Check Annotations

  ENTRY Tablebase ▸

      ENTRY online lookup
      ENTRY local folder…
  ENTRY Opening Explorer

  ENTRY Training Set from Games…
  ENTRY Check Game Results…

MENU View
  ENTRY Panes ▸
    SUBMENU Panes
      ENTRY board
      ENTRY editor
      ENTRY game list
      ENTRY players
      ENTRY events
      ENTRY sites
      ENTRY annotators

      ENTRY explorer
  ENTRY Layout ▸

      ENTRY Load Layout ▸
      ENTRY Save Layout
      ENTRY Save Layout As…
      ENTRY Manage Layouts…
  ENTRY Toolbars ▸
    SUBMENU Toolbars
      ENTRY per toolbar checkbuttons
  SEP
  ENTRY Theme ▸
  ENTRY Colors ▸
  ENTRY Icon Size ▸
  ENTRY Language ▸
  SEP
  ENTRY Increase Font Size Ctrl+Shift++
  ENTRY Decrease Font Size Ctrl+Shift+−
  SEP
  ENTRY Full-Screen F11
  ENTRY Show Log… Ctrl+L
  ENTRY Tip of the Day…

  ENTRY Help F1
  SEP
  ENTRY Bug Report
  ENTRY Feature Request
  SEP
  ENTRY About Chesswiz…
